rows.quote: We extracted pQTL data from 2940 European‐ancestry participants in the UKB‐PPP database (B. B. Sun et al. 2023).
rows.reference_quote: Sun , B. B. , J. Chiou , M. Traylor , et al. 2023 . “ Plasma Proteomic Associations With Genetics and Health in the UK Biobank .” Nature 622 , no. 7982 : 329 – 338 . 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6 . 37794186 PMC10567551
rows.coder_note: The sentence attributes the pQTL data to Sun 2023 (DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6, several dictionary rows) and states European-ancestry participants, the ancestry of the discovery row alone (rule E); the '2940' participants figure is the sample size of no row and identifies no other release (rule H). The 'Emdin et al. 2017' citation in the study-design sentence is a methods paper and is not used.

rows.quote: Ferroptosis‐associated pQTLs were derived from 4907 Icelandic individuals in the deCODE database (Ferkingstad et al. 2021).
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad , E. , P. Sulem , B. A. Atlason , et al. 2021 . “ Large‐Scale Integration of the Plasma Proteome With Genetics and Disease .” Nature Genetics 53 , no. 12 : 1712 – 1721 . 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w . 34857953
rows.coder_note: The sentence attributes the deCODE pQTLs to Ferkingstad et al. 2021, whose DOI 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w is the Ferkingstad 2021 row's alone; the '4907 Icelandic individuals' figure is the sample size of no row and identifies no other release (rule H).
